title: Where Are We? Evaluating LLM Performance on African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 24 large language models on the SAHARA benchmark across 517 African languages using various NLP tasks (classification, text generation, multiple-choice reasoning, and token-level classification) to measure performance disparities between well-resourced languages and underrepresented Indigenous African languages.

Analyzing the correlation between language policy, dataset volume/diversity, and downstream model performance (using Exact Match, F1, Accuracy, spBLEU, and RougeL metrics) to demonstrate how models systematically favor languages with historical and institutional support.
